name: Jeremoth
overview: Jeremoth was a male chief officer of the tribe of Naphtali, serving in a leadership capacity among the Naphtalites. He is specifically identified as the son of Azriel, indicating his family lineage within the tribe. There are no additional notes recorded about his life or ministry.
namesAndTitles: The name Jeremoth means 'swollen or obese,' a proper name that is not indicated as being given directly by God. This meaning reflects the Hebrew origin of the name but does not carry further theological significance in the biblical text.
familyAndRelationships: Jeremoth is explicitly recorded as the son of Azriel. Beyond this father-son relationship, Scripture does not provide further family details about him.
scriptureSignificance: Jeremoth's significance lies in his role as a chief officer for the Naphtalites, highlighting his position of authority within the tribal leadership. His mention in 1 Chronicles 27:19 situates him within the organized governance of Israel during the period of David's reign. This demonstrates the orderly structure God established among His people, with appointed leaders like Jeremoth overseeing tribal affairs.
